title: Tree Preservation Orders
description: A TPO is a legal document made, administered and enforced by us as the local planning authority. It protects specified trees and woodlands, and prevents cutting down, uprooting, topping, lopping, wilful damage or destruction of trees (including cutting roots) without our permission. A TPO can protect anything from a single tree to all trees within a defined group or woodland. There are currently around 700 TPOs in County Durham.

title: Household waste recycling centres
description: A spatial dataset showing Durham County Council's Household Waste Recycling Centres There is a statutory obligation under the Environment Protection Act 1990, section 51, 1b which states that: (1) It shall be the duty of each waste disposal authority to arrange (b) for places to be provided at which persons resident in its area may deposit their household waste and for the disposal of waste so deposited. To find out more about recycling centres visit: https://www.durham.gov.uk/hwrc
